chord: D_i = Euclidean distance between canonical u/v Point geometries; LineString endpoints verified against those nodes

circuity.edge: L_i / D_i for D_i above zero-chord tolerance
circuity.historical_H4: not used or claimed supported; Phase 7G formulas are explicitly defined planar ratios
circuity.mean_edge_circuity: arithmetic mean of individual L_i / D_i ratios
circuity.network_circuity: sum(L_i) / sum(D_i) over eligible positive-chord edges

figure_semantics: SVG rose plots mirror each [0,180) axial observation across 180 degrees as an undirected axis; they are not traffic bearings

histogram.boundary_rule: angle modulo 180; snap only within configured tolerance of an exact boundary; then floor(angle/bin_width); [start,end)

length: L_i = recomputed canonical LineString.length; stored length_local checked within configured tolerance

orientation.chord: one endpoint-chord orientation per eligible physical canonical edge; internal curvature not represented
orientation.convention: 0 degrees North, 90 East, clockwise, axial normalization to [0,180)
orientation.segment: one local axial orientation per positive consecutive LineString coordinate pair; vertices are geometry vertices, not graph nodes

scope: planar physical-street geometry, circuity, axial orientation, entropy, and fourfold order
